kypExtensions.summary: Reading apolipoproteins as an address system: origin tags (B48 intestine vs B100 liver), keys (apo CII unlocks LPL; apoE unlocks remnant/IDL uptake), and license (apo AI licenses LCAT on HDL).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists the five apolipoproteins and their functions in a table; unifying them as one three-part address system (origin/key/license) that maps onto the numbered transport steps is KYP's integrative model.
